title: Halo: Combat Evolved Mobile (HCEMobile)
description: Halo CE as an installable web app for iPhone/Android; play in the browser or add to home screen.

title: Quake III Arena (q3.pieter.com)
description: Quake III multiplayer in the browser (unofficial, non-commercial).

title: WASM Arcade (GTA / Minecraft web ports)
description: Collection of WebAssembly game ports incl. GTA and Minecraft builds.

title: Test Drive
description: Faithful C/SDL3 port of Test Drive (1987, DOS/EGA), reverse-engineered from the original; needs your own game files.

title: Test Drive Enhanced
description: Enhanced Test Drive (1987) on SDL3: higher-resolution road view, longer draw distance, 60 fps; needs your own game files.

title: Test Drive II: The Duel
description: Faithful C/SDL3 port of Test Drive II: The Duel (1989, DOS/EGA), reverse-engineered from the original; needs your own game files.

title: Test Drive II: The Duel Enhanced
description: Enhanced Test Drive II on SDL3: road view at 4x resolution, 60 fps, 180-unit draw distance; needs your own game files.

title: Test Drive III: The Passion
description: Faithful C/SDL3 port of Test Drive III: The Passion (1990, DOS/VGA), reverse-engineered from the original; needs your own game files.

title: Test Drive III: The Passion Enhanced
description: Enhanced Test Drive III on SDL3: smooth high-resolution 3D view, longer draw distance, smooth steering; needs your own game files.

title: Street Rod
description: Faithful C/SDL3 port of Street Rod (1989, DOS/VGA), reverse-engineered from the original; needs your own game files.

title: Street Rod Enhanced
description: Enhanced Street Rod (1989) on SDL3 with a smooth, high-resolution road view; needs your own game files.

title: Street Rod 2: The Next Generation
description: Faithful C/SDL3 port of Street Rod 2 (1991, DOS), reverse-engineered from the original; needs your own game files.

title: Aces of the Pacific
description: Faithful C/SDL3 port of Aces of the Pacific (1992, DOS/VGA), reverse-engineered from the original; needs your own game files.

title: Aces of the Pacific Enhanced
description: Enhanced Aces of the Pacific on SDL3: smooth high-resolution 3D view, longer view distance, distance haze, key bindings.

title: JetStrike
description: Faithful C/SDL3 port of JetStrike (1994, DOS CD-ROM), reverse-engineered from the original; needs your own game files.

title: JetStrike Enhanced
description: Enhanced JetStrike on SDL3 with a wider 640x360 mission view; needs your own copy of the DOS CD-ROM version.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 1.05
description: C/SDL3 port of Microsoft Flight Simulator 1.05 (IBM PC booter, 1982), every routine reimplemented; needs your own disk image.
